remarks: Welcome to this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom townhouse located in a desirable and well-kept complex offering comfort, convenience, and great community amenities. This inviting home features a spacious layout with plenty of room to live, work, and entertain. The primary bedroom includes a private ensuite full bathroom, creating a comfortable retreat at the end of the day. Two additional bedrooms provide flexibility for guests or a home office. The finished lower level adds valuable living space and includes a dedicated laundry room, perfect for a family room, gym, or recreation area. Step outside to enjoy your private deck at the back of the unit, ideal for relaxing or enjoying quiet outdoor time. Parking is conveniently located directly in front of the unit, making everyday living easy and accessible. Residents of the complex also enjoy association amenities including a pool and pool house, perfect for summertime relaxation and socializing. This home offers the ideal combination of comfortable living, community amenities, and convenient layout-a great opportunity you won't want to miss.
